name: GetAllTasks
label: Get All Tasks
description: Retrieves multiple Salesforce tasks using SOQL.

fields.name: Credential
fields.label: Credential to connect with
fields.description: The credential to connect with (JSON containing InstanceUrl, AccessToken, ApiVersion).

fields.name: ReturnAll
fields.label: Return All
fields.description: If enabled, retrieves all tasks without limit. If disabled, uses the Limit value.

fields.name: Limit
fields.label: Limit
fields.description: Maximum number of tasks to retrieve. Only visible when 'Return All' is disabled.

fields.name: Options
fields.label: Options
fields.description: Additional properties to include in the request (e.g., fields to select).

fields.name: Tasks
fields.label: Tasks
fields.description: The list of retrieved tasks as JSON array.

fields.name: Response
fields.label: Response
fields.description: The raw JSON response from Salesforce.
